long_biography.plain_text:
Before energy drinks, Russell Savage ran an unsuccessful California Assembly campaign. That experience brought him to Maurice Kanbar, a friend of his father and the founder of Skyy Vodka, who hired him for product development. Savage later pitched an energy drink, left when Kanbar declined it and raised launch capital by mortgaging his Sausalito condominium.

Rockstar entered the market with a larger 16-ounce can, distinctive branding and aggressive street promotion. Savage built it into a major international energy-drink business while retaining a controlling stake. PepsiCo bought the company in 2020, crystallizing the fortune he had created in beverages. He later returned to the category as an investor, accumulating a substantial position in Celsius Holdings and publicly pressing for management change.
